references.text: Both verses are part of the same genealogy and illustrate the unbroken line of God's preservation of humanity before the flood.
This verse confirms that the fixed cycle of life and offspring applies to all links in the genealogical chain before the flood.
Shows that God's plan to preserve humanity through family lines continues uninterrupted even after the flood.
Adam as the ancestor sets the pattern for the entire genealogy, of which Kenan is a part, and emphasizes continuity in God's creation plan.
Illustrates that God's blessing concerning fruitfulness and family lines was restored and carried forward after the flood.
Confirms that God's plan to preserve humanity through family lines continues uninterrupted in the new world after the flood.
As part of the same list, this verse together with Kenan's verse shows the unbroken chain of life and God's faithfulness in every generation.
As part of the same list, this verse shows that God's preservation of the family line continued all the way to Noah and the flood.
Shows that God's plan to preserve humanity through family lines continued uninterrupted after the flood through Shem's line.
